title: Quick catch-up — missed our intro, two reschedule options
text:
Quick catch-up — missed our intro, two reschedule options

From: Alex Rodriguez <alex@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-12 15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro to Redwood — quick sync

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — I booked a 30-minute intro for Wed, Sep 14 at 10:00 AM PT via the link you sent. Looking forward to a brief overview and to discuss latency/cost comparisons for our use case.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Rodriguez
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Analytics
alex@acmeanalytics.com

---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 10:45 -0700
Subject: Missed our sync — quick reschedule?

Hi Alex —

Looks like you weren’t able to join the slot this morning. No worries — these things happen. I wanted to offer two short options to get us back on track:

  • Thu, Sep 16 @ 10:00 AM PT (30 min)
  • Fri, Sep 17 @ 9:00 AM PT (30 min)

If neither works, you can pick any open slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30?u=acme

I attached a short intro deck so you have context before we chat (2–3 slides you can skim).

Attachment: Redwood-IntroDeck.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)
Attachment: reschedule.ics (calendar invite stub)

Looking forward —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com

P.S. Ben (cc) will join if we go into technical questions about throughput/quantization.

---
From: Redwood Auto-Sequence <no-reply@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 10:46 -0700
Subject: Missed you — quick reschedule link

This is an automated follow-up from Redwood Inference. We noticed you missed your scheduled demo with Tessa. If you'd still like to speak, please pick a new time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30?u=acme

If you've already rebooked, please disregard.

--- Forwarded message from Tessa Morgan ---
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 10:47 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Missed our sync — quick reschedule?

Ben — FYI, Alex missed the slot. I dropped our standard auto-sequence and offered two specific options + calendar link and attached the deck. If he replies with deep infra questions, can you jump in?

Thanks,
Tessa

---
From: Alex Rodriguez <alex@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 16:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed our sync — quick reschedule?

Hi Tessa —

Huge apologies — got pulled into a customer incident and couldn’t make it. The deck looks useful. I can do Thu, Sep 16 at 10:00 AM PT. Please send a calendar invite and include Ben if he’s free.

Also wanted to surface one ask ahead of the call: can you bring a short slide on multi-region routing and SLO guarantees? That’s our primary ask.

Thanks,
Alex
